layouts.name: Gateway Road 1
layouts.description: The supplied Road 1 configuration retains the original smooth southern return, northern inner hairpin and oval-front-straight return. The operator distinguishes its 1.6-mile course from the later 2.0-mile extension. This draft follows the original paved route visible in the pinned public-domain 2019 NAIP image; independent historical public-node alignment aided branch identification. The newer southern extension, kart course, dragway and pit road are excluded. Coordinates come from independent public georeferencing, without fitting the supplied diagram or scalar. Historical direction and fine corner alignment remain draft. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 2602.8 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
